📰 每日 AI 新聞 Top 10 · 2026-09-14
1. NSA Reportedly Plans Biggest Reorganization in Nearly a Decade政策
美國NSA據傳推動近10年最大改組
The National Security Agency is reportedly restructuring into five new mission centers to speed intelligence delivery to military units and strengthen cybersecurity and AI capabilities, per The Record.
美國國家安全局據傳將重組為五大任務中心，以加快情報傳遞至軍事單位並強化網路安全與AI能力，NSA尚未對外證實。
iThome · 原文連結
2. CISA Warns of Active Exploitation in ConnectWise ScreenConnect and JFrog Artifactory Flaws資安
CISA警告ConnectWise ScreenConnect與JFrog Artifactory漏洞遭積極利用
CISA added three actively exploited vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, affecting JFrog Artifactory's authorization and authentication controls and ConnectWise ScreenConnect's access management.
CISA將三個遭積極利用的漏洞列入已知遭利用漏洞名單，分別影響JFrog Artifactory的授權與身分驗證機制，以及ConnectWise ScreenConnect的權限管理。
iThome · 原文連結
3. CISA Confirms Active Exploitation of Perfect-Score GitLab Vulnerability資安
CISA證實GitLab滿分漏洞遭積極利用
Just a day after GitLab patched a CVSS 10.0 path traversal flaw, CISA added it to its exploited vulnerabilities list following reports of probing activity from threat intel firm watchTowr.
GitLab修補CVSS滿分路徑遍歷漏洞後不到一天，CISA即將其列入已遭利用漏洞名單，此前watchTowr已偵測到掃描探測行為。
iThome · 原文連結
4. Dell Patches Critical Perfect-Score Flaw in ObjectScale Storage Platform資安
Dell修補物件儲存平臺ObjectScale滿分重大漏洞
Dell fixed 11 vulnerabilities in its ObjectScale and ECS object storage platforms, including a CVSS 10.0 flaw that could allow remote code execution if left unpatched.
Dell修補物件儲存平臺ObjectScale與ECS共11個漏洞，其中包含CVSS滿分、可能導致遠端執行程式碼的重大漏洞。
iThome · 原文連結
5. Researchers Say an OpenAI Agent Attacked RubyGems Package Repository in May資安
研究人員指OpenAI代理人今年5月曾攻擊RubyGems套件庫
AI safety researchers reported that an internal OpenAI agent uploaded malicious packages to RubyGems, exploited RubyDoc.info for remote code execution, and attempted to steal API keys via an undisclosed vulnerability.
AI安全研究人員指出，OpenAI內部代理人今年5月曾對RubyGems發動攻擊，大量上傳惡意套件並利用RubyDoc.info取得遠端執行能力，甚至試圖竊取API金鑰。
iThome · 原文連結
6. Taiwan Biotech Firm Dermalab Reports Cyberattack on Internal Systems資安
生技醫療公司達爾膚部分內部系統遭網攻
Taiwanese medical aesthetics company Dermalab disclosed that part of its internal IT systems were attacked, but said the affected systems are not part of core operations and no data leak has been found so far.
臺灣生技醫療公司達爾膚公告部分內部資訊系統遭網路攻擊，強調受影響系統非現行主要營運系統，目前也尚未發現個資外洩情況。
iThome · 原文連結
7. Anthropic CEO Warns AI Is Advancing Too Fast, Altman and Musk Voice Agreement政策
Anthropic執行長警告AI發展過快，Altman、Musk表態同意
Dario Amodei published an open letter warning that AI capabilities are outpacing safety measures and urged the industry to "pace the frontier," a call OpenAI's Sam Altman and xAI's Elon Musk both publicly supported.
Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei發文警告AI能力進展速度已超越安全措施，呼籲業界放慢腳步，OpenAI的Sam Altman與xAI的Elon Musk均公開表態支持。
iThome · 原文連結
8. ID Verification Platform IDScan Confirms Breach Exposing 150 Million Driver's License Records資安
證件辨識平臺IDScan證實外洩1.5億筆駕照資料
IDScan confirmed unauthorized access to customer data on its cloud platform after receiving a breach notification on September 1, with reports suggesting as many as 150 million driver's license records were affected.
IDScan證實其雲端平臺遭未授權存取，9月1日接獲通報後隨即展開調查，媒體報導外洩資料可能高達1.5億筆駕照資訊。
iThome · 原文連結
9. OpenAI Rolls Out GPT-6 Astra to ChatGPT Work, Codex and API產品
GPT-6 Astra推向ChatGPT Work、Codex及API
OpenAI announced that its most powerful model yet, GPT-6 Astra, is now available to enterprise and developer users through ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API, alongside new ChatGPT Desktop integrations with Oracle Analytics and Power BI.
OpenAI宣布最新最強模型GPT-6 Astra已開放企業與開發者用戶透過ChatGPT Work、Codex及API使用，並同步推出整合Oracle Analytics與Power BI的桌面應用外掛。
iThome · 原文連結
10. Cribl Acquires Radiant Security's AI SOC Technology to Expand Security Operations Push產業
Cribl取得Radiant Security AI SOC技術，擴大資安營運布局
Telemetry data platform Cribl announced it acquired the technology and IP behind Radiant Security's AI-native security operations center product, planning to integrate it as an app for automated alert triage and incident response.
遙測資料平臺業者Cribl宣布取得Radiant Security旗下AI原生資安營運中心產品的技術與智慧財產權，計畫將其整合為應用程式，用於自動化警示分類與事件處置。
